title: Epp cover with reduced equidimensional special fibre
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a complete Noetherian normal local domain of dimension $d\geq2$ and mixed characteristic $(0,p)$ [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring, def-weil-pbc-normal-ring, def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Then there are a complete discrete valuation ring $W$ of mixed characteristic $(0,p)$ with perfect residue field $k_0$ [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], a uniformizer $\pi\in W$, a complete Noetherian normal local domain $(C,\mathfrak n)$, an injective local ring map $A\hookrightarrow C$ making $C$ a finite $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and an injective local map $W\hookrightarrow C$ such that $C/\pi C$ is reduced and equidimensional of dimension $d-1$. Here reduced means having no nonzero nilpotents, and equidimensional means that all quotients by minimal prime ideals have the indicated dimension. The residue field $k'=C/\mathfrak n$ is finite over $A/\mathfrak m$, with its specified inclusion of $k_0$, and $\dim C=d$.

source.place: Expose IV 4.2.3 (normalized Epp base change), 4.2.4 (generically reduced Cartier divisors on normal schemes), and first sentence of 4.2.5 (connected component); IV 3.1.2–3.1.3 and 3.2.3 are the Epp inputs. This is the reduced-fibre preparation, not Theorem 4.2.2.
